name: CAP patch, adult member without grade
size_basis: CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-2, tile "Adult member without grade pursuing officer grade": 385 x 212 px against the 1.15 x 1.25 in Lt Col cloth patch in the same figure (295 x 319 px, 1 in leaf + 1/8 in border) = 256 px/in
provenance: measured from CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-2; lettering is the sleeve CAP glyph set stretched to the measured word box

mounts.uniform: ABU coat collar / OCP, ABU and tactical caps
mounts.rule: worn where officers wear grade insignia by adults without grade pursuing officer promotion (CAPR 39-1 1.4.1, Fig A5-2)
senior members without grade wear the blank 2 x 2 in dark blue square instead (7.1.1.2.1): use rank-ocp-square-blank
